question: As announced on June 17, 2025, which of the following institutes have developed a novel one-step colloidal synthesis method for fabricating PEGylated semi-shells (SS) with nano-cup morphology at room temperature to treat cancer?

options.text: Institute of Nano Science and Technology (INST), Raebareli
Institute of Nano Science and Technology (INST), Dehradun
Institute of Nano Science and Technology (INST), Mohali
Institute of Nano Science and Technology (INST), Chandigarh

solution:
The correct answer is __**Institute of Nano Science and Technology (INST), Mohali**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Institute of Nano Science and Technology (INST), Mohali**, has developed a novel one-step colloidal synthesis method to fabricate PEGylated semi-shells (SS) with nano-cup morphology at room temperature.
 
• This breakthrough synthesis method is aimed at enhancing the treatment of **cancer**, as the nano-cup morphology allows for better drug delivery and targeting of cancer cells.
 
• The announcement regarding this innovation was made on **June 17, 2025**, highlighting its significance in the field of nanotechnology and cancer therapy.
 
• The PEGylated semi-shells are designed to improve **biocompatibility** and reduce immunogenicity, making them suitable for medical applications.
